_note: Replace <owner>/<repo> in `repo` when the plugin repository is public, then remove ui.installNote. One command per agent; {repo} is filled in from `repo`. Each command is that agent's own install route, read from its CLI help on 2026-11-12: Codex and Grok accept the repository's Claude-format manifest (checked with `codex plugin marketplace add` on the local folder and `grok plugin validate`), Gemini CLI loads it as an extension (`gemini-extension.json`, checked with `gemini extensions link`). Cursor's manifest (.cursor-plugin/) follows its docs and has not been run. opencode has no plugin route for skills, so it copies the two folders.

agents.name: Codex
agents.command: codex plugin marketplace add {repo} && codex plugin add standup@standup
